nodes.author: BluesFanK
nodes.text: @WastewaterSCAN @michael_hoerger If only the levels would stay low.

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Low’ category with low concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/16aDyFpwTf

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, the LP.8.1 variant (a descendant of KP.1) in brown (40.5%) and other KP.1 variants in light green (5.3%) make up around 46% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/c7PQGKv9a4

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 13% and 27% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/KhIDNmIyqm

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 27 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 8 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 5/21/25, 17 states reported infected cattle herds. The most recent wastewater detections have been in AK, NC & NJ. https://t.co/KMOzua676m

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV:RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 8% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/9lhOmdPOLQ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally because it is not in onset. 48.5% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/0kAoFmO83a

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘Medium’ category nationally with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/pR4gg9jS3V
